scope: Small invited Sepolia mint trial; not a mainnet or broad public launch review.
recommendedBeforeWiderSharing: Observe successful mints from a few independent tester accounts and another wallet/browser; the two confirmed mints so far used the same wallet.
initialInviteRequirements: Explain Ethereum Sepolia, zero mint price, Sepolia ETH for gas, and one mint per wallet per composition.
Provide a Blockscout viewing link because the installed Rabby NFT gallery has no Sepolia filter.
Ask testers for transaction hashes, chosen composition, browser/wallet, and exact errors.
optionalDeferred: Live transfer testing: intentionally skipped for this mint-focused trial.
Mobile coverage unless mobile support will be advertised.
unchangedLimitations: Strict PNG pixel re-render equality was not reproduced on this Mac; preserved export bytes and portable checks pass.
No independent security audit. Public RPC availability is a dependency; errors still block signing checks.
actionsTaken: Read-only verification, authorized Blockscout source publication, and local evidence/documentation updates. No invite sent, website uploaded, or blockchain transaction submitted.
